pr_title: Allow editing push mirrors after creation
pr_body:
Allow users to edit the sync interval for existing push mirrors. Currently, there is no way to modify the interval once the mirror is created.
Screenshots ## Before ## After ### On hover ### Edit modal ### Only valid times are allowed
Fixes #21295
pr_comments:
Thanks @wxiaoguang for the quick and immediate support.

This pr is ready for review.
+1 approval needed to walk this PR.

issue_context.title: Add option to edit mirror interval on repo push mirrors
issue_context.body: at the moment you have to recreate a push mirror if you want to change the interval :/
comments:

review_comments: Why start a mirror immediately after the interval changed?

I have limited background information on the conditions for pushing to `mirror_module.AddPushMirrorToQueue(m.ID)`. However, I observed its implementation in the context of `push-mirror-sync`  where it is evident that pushing to the queue is necessary for updates.

Quick question: Will our scheduler automatically fetch the ID at the time of periodic sync?

My thoughts : If there are updates within the given interval, it is necessary to update the queue accordingly. In case the previous question is considered invalid, we can omit this statement.
It's better to add these comments on the code.
